description: Where does subquery nesting depth stop being accepted, and at which phase? Only the depth varies (n = 10, 32, 49, 50, 51, 64) over the one-row table ONE: n scalar subqueries nested in the select list, and n IN-subqueries nested in WHERE. Each text is opened directly with the standard capture. Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
